parts.t: Chartwell sits at the pinnacle of West Vancouver real estate — quite literally and figuratively. Perched high above the city, this ultra-exclusive neighbourhood is home to some of Metro Vancouver's finest estate properties, with sweeping views of the ocean, islands, and mountains. The Chartwell address is among the most prestigious in Canada.
